name: Engineer Assessment
purpose: Test and potentially deliver a short, evidence-based engineering assessment that elicits creativity, technical design and cooperation through at most three ten-minute case answers, while keeping hiring claims dependent on independent outcome validation.
value_promise: Engineers receive brief, evidence-linked feedback; employers may receive a role-specific decision aid only if prospective independent validation supports it.

includes: Versioned three-session challenge and participant feedback
Question generation, review, exposure and retirement
Possible employer decision aid only after separate accepted gates
excludes: Research project identity or completed research claims
Current release, deployment or employment-use approval

claim_ceiling: Candidate Product identity and research design only. No accepted semantic owner, definition admission, participant collection, selection validity, employment authority or release.
